text:
```yaml
name: Fix Comment Typo in Project Update Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  fix-typo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: '2.14'

      - name: Format code
        run: |
          dart format -o none lib/src/workflows/update_project_references.workflow.dart
        env:
          PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/bin:$PATH

      - name: Fix comment typo
        run: |
          sed -i 's/_updateLocalSdkReference/_updateLocalSdkReference/g' lib/src/workflows/update_project_references.workflow.dart

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add lib/src/workflows/update_project_references.workflow.dart
          git commit -m "fix: fix typo in _updateLocalSdkReference doc comment"
          git push origin main
```
